pages.title: Quantum Shield
pages.text: Attacks with original damage $(l)below 1000$() are fully absorbed while the equipped pieces have enough energy.$(br2)$(6)Cost: 100 FE per absorbed damage point.$()

pages.title: Armor Modules
pages.text: $(b)Helmet:$() Night Vision.$(br)$(b)Chestplate:$() Speed II and flight; flight costs 10 FE/t.$(br)$(b)Leggings:$() Jump Boost III.$(br)$(b)Boots:$() Slow Falling.$(br2)$(8)At zero charge the shield and energy-powered flight stop working.$()
